name: tokenos-tokenomics-designer
description: Design token allocation and vesting in one prompt — allocation table, cliff/linear vesting, 48-month circulating supply chart, FDV and sanity warnings.

interface.longDescription:
Describe your token and get a complete tokenomics model: allocation buckets with token amounts, vesting (TGE unlock, cliff, linear), a month-by-month circulating-supply schedule rendered as a chart, FDV and initial market cap at a launch price, and warnings where the design deviates from what buyers and exchanges expect. Presets for DeFi, gaming, meme, infrastructure and DAO tokens, or pass custom buckets.

Tools:
• design_tokenomics — Build a full allocation + vesting model with a 48-month circulating-supply schedule, FDV / initial market cap and sanity warnings.
• vesting_schedule — Month-by-month unlock table for one allocation given TGE unlock %, cliff and linear vesting months.

Targets questions like: “tokenomics template”; “token allocation calculator”; “token vesting schedule calculator”; “tokenomics design”; “token distribution model”; “token unlock schedule”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/tokenomics-designer

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
defaultPrompt: Design tokenomics for a DeFi token with 1B supply and a $0.02 launch price
Give me a gaming token distribution with team vesting
Vesting schedule: 150M tokens, 12-month cliff, 36 months linear

positive.prompt: Design tokenomics for a DeFi token called ACME with 1B supply and a $0.02 launch price
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an allocation table, vesting labels, FDV $20M, initial market cap, circulating-supply milestones and the chart widget.

positive.prompt: Give me a gaming token distribution with team vesting
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the game-economy preset with player incentives, team cliff/vesting and liquidity at launch.

positive.prompt: Vesting schedule: 150M tokens, 12-month cliff, 36 months linear
positive.expected_behavior: Returns monthly unlock amounts, cumulative totals and the month the allocation is fully unlocked.

positive.prompt: Tokenomics with Team 40% (20% at TGE, 12 months linear) and Public 60% at launch, 1000 tokens total
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the model plus warnings about team share and team tokens at launch.

positive.prompt: Tokenomics with Team 50% and Treasury 30% only
positive.expected_behavior: Tool returns an error that allocations must total 100%; the assistant asks how to allocate the remaining 20%.

negative.description: Price prediction — No tool call; the assistant does not forecast prices.
negative.prompt: What will my token price be in 6 months?

negative.description: Existing asset analysis — General knowledge answer without calling the designer (it models new tokens).
Legal advice — No tool call; the assistant recommends qualified counsel.
negative.prompt: Is my token a security under US law?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
